description: End of day option chain of one underlying for one expiry on one date: settle price, open interest, contracts and more for each strike and option type, plus iv, delta, gamma, theta and vega on contracts that traded that day (Black-76 on the same-expiry forward; iv 0.14 means 14%). On an expiry date the nearest expiry is the one expiring that day, which has no Greeks: pass the next expiry from fo_expiries. Required: symbol. date defaults to the latest day with data; expiry defaults to the nearest expiry. A full chain can run to hundreds of rows, so this returns the 40 rows with strikes nearest the underlying by default, up to 200, sorted by strike (meta.centered_on). Use strike_min, strike_max and option_type to pick another part of the chain. End of day NSE equity derivatives from 2010-01-04, no BSE, no intraday. Tier: needs a Retail or Pro key (https://tejhq.dev/upgrade).

date.description: Trading date. Default: latest. Format YYYY-MM-DD.

expiry.description: Expiry date. Default: nearest. See fo_expiries. Format YYYY-MM-DD.

option_type.description: Only this option type: CE or PE, or CA or PA before 2011.

symbol.description: Underlying symbol, for example NIFTY, BANKNIFTY, RELIANCE. Case does not matter.

name: fo_chain
title: Option chain
